text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to secure a definitive victory in 
the Shuka Sho, Vivlos desires solid, 
rigorous training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though the Trainer had initially 
prioritized stabilizing her condition, 
hearing her passionate resolve changes 
their mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While promoting explosive growth through 
low-strain training, it was decided to 
prepare for both the Shion Stakes and the 
Shuka Sho.
